confirmed.cause: Bounded-finalization verification relies on the operation under test to unblock the test and on an unbounded post-interrupt child Wait.
confirmed.evidence: candidate-2/run_test.go:89-97 calls Run synchronously with a finalizer blocked on ctx.Done and no independent case guard. candidate-2/cmd/finalize/main_test.go:85-87 waits synchronously for the interrupted child and stderr reader; cleanup cannot run while this wait is blocked. Supplied frozen sensitivity output documents the unbounded-finalization variant reaching the package-wide 30s panic; that result was supplied, not independently rerun. Immutable candidate suites and probes pass on both actual compilers.
confirmed.correction: Use a separate bounded test controller around Run and the child lifecycle, make callbacks releasable on failure, and kill/reap a stalled child before reporting a case-level failure. Keep production completion assertions.
confirmed.reconciliation: One test-controller ownership cause across in-process and process finalization; moderate because regressions are eventually detected by a package-wide timeout, with poor isolation and delayed diagnosis. No immutable production hang is claimed.
